mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id AS "notificationId",n.notification_type AS "type",n.title AS "title",n.content AS "content", n.target_type AS "targetType",n.target_id AS "targetId",n.post_id AS "postId", CASE WHEN n.read_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "read", TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(CAST(n.created_at AS TIMESTAMP),'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt",a.nickname AS "actorName" FROM user_notifications n LEFT JOIN users a ON a.user_id=n.actor_id WHERE n.user_id=#{value} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.notification_id DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE user_notifications SET read_at=NVL(read_at,SYSDATE) WHERE notification_id=#{notificationId} AND user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE user_notifications SET read_at=SYSDATE WHERE user_id=#{value} AND read_at IS NULL
